title.zh: 【Firmus 拟于 10 月 23 日在澳大利亚 IPO，筹集至少 50 亿美元】
title.en: 【Firmus 拟于 10 月 23 日在澳大利亚 IPO，筹集至少 50 亿美元】

current_state.zh:
由比特币矿企转型为 AI 基础设施公司的 Firmus Grid Ltd. 已将其首次公开募股定价为每股 11 澳元，寻求通过其在澳大利亚的 IPO 至少筹集 50 亿澳元，这将是澳大利亚有史以来规模最大的 IPO 之一。按此定价，公司估值约为 437 亿澳元（303 亿美元），其澳交所上市日期已更改为 10 月 23 日。

此次发行将是澳大利亚有史以来规模最大的 IPO 之一，也让一家由比特币挖矿起家的公司站到了人工智能与高性能计算投资周期的中心，报道提到其投资方包括 Jane Street、黑石集团和英伟达。该公司被视为受益于亚太地区人工智能基础设施需求的激增。

每股 11 澳元的定价低于此前最高 500 亿澳元的估值预期，上市日期也已更改为 10 月 23 日。中文报道将募资目标表述为 50 亿美元，而英文市场摘要给出的口径为 50 亿澳元，部分报道提及最高可达 55 亿澳元。
current_state.en: Firmus Grid, the Australian bitcoin-mining firm turned AI data-center operator, priced its ASX IPO at A$11 per share to raise at least A$5 billion at a ~US$30.3 billion valuation, with listing moved to October 23.

updates.detailed_summary_en: Firmus Grid, the Australian bitcoin-mining firm turned AI data-center operator, priced its ASX IPO at A$11 per share to raise at least A$5 billion at a ~US$30.3 billion valuation, with listing moved to October 23.
updates.background_zh: Firmus 于 2019 年在澳大利亚塔斯马尼亚州以比特币挖矿业务起家，目前在澳大利亚和新加坡有多个数据中心项目正在筹建。今年 8 月，该公司从包括 Jane Street、黑石集团和英伟达在内的投资者处获得 20 亿美元的投资承诺；此前在 4 月由 Coatue Management 领投的一轮融资中筹集了 5.05 亿美元。这一转型反映了更广泛的趋势：比特币矿企正把电力合同、土地和冷却设施转向人工智能与高性能计算负载，尤其是在 2024 年减半将区块补贴从 6.25 BTC 降至 3.125 BTC 之后。
updates.background_en: Firmus started in 2019 in Tasmania, Australia, as a bitcoin-mining business and now has multiple data-center projects under way in Australia and Singapore. In August it secured US$2 billion in investment commitments from investors including Jane Street, Blackstone and Nvidia, after raising US$505 million in an April round led by Coatue Management. The pivot reflects a broader trend of bitcoin miners reallocating power contracts, land and cooling infrastructure to AI and high-performance computing workloads, particularly after the 2024 halving cut the block subsidy from 6.25 BTC to 3.125 BTC.
updates.market_impact_zh: 此次上市把机构股权资本导入一家由挖矿起家、如今建设 AI 数据中心的公司，可能影响市场对拥有类似电力与场地资产的上市比特币矿企的估值方式，以及它们进入公开市场的难易程度。它同时凸显了与挖矿相关的电力与基础设施正转向 AI/HPC 负载，长期来看这一变化会影响比特币算力经济，但该 IPO 本身并未改变加密市场的准入或协议运行。
updates.market_impact_en: The listing channels institutional equity capital into a mining-origin company now building AI data centers, which bears on how listed bitcoin miners with comparable power and site assets are valued and how readily they can tap public markets. It also underscores the reallocation of mining-linked power and infrastructure toward AI/HPC workloads, a shift that feeds into bitcoin hashrate economics over time, although the IPO itself does not change crypto market access or protocol operations.
